name: Internal reporting on specific customers blocked, withdrawn or never raised
description: Staff or managers discourage unusual-activity reports on a customer, reverse escalations, or reports for a particular relationship repeatedly fail to arrive at the compliance function.
fp: Reports may be legitimately closed after review or consolidated into one case. Look for patterns tied to one manager or portfolio.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance on Correspondent Banking Services, 2016
Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Sound management of risks related to money laundering and financing of terrorism, 2014 (revised 2020)

links.name: Internal reporting on specific customers blocked, withdrawn or never raised
links.ctx: Core complicity sign, as the human reporting chain is the control being neutralised.
